question.text: How many EU member states will the AI Act National Implementation tracker classify as having clear market surveillance and notifying authorities on December 1, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the number of National Competent Authorities classified as "Clear" at the EU's  [Overview of all AI Act National Implementation Plans](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/national-implementation-plans/) tracker, when checked by Metaculus on or after December 1, 2026.

research:
## 1. Resolution source

- 2026-10-26 (fetched today): the tracker says **"9 Member States have designated both market surveillance and notifying authorities"**. It counts 9 as Clear, 12 as Partial clarity and 6 as Unclear. All 27 have fundamental rights authorities, but that count does not decide the question. [AIAct tracker](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/national-implementation-plans/)
- The 9 Clear states are Cyprus, Denmark, Finland, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Lithuania, Malta and Slovenia.
- Partial clarity: Czech Republic, France, Germany, Latvia, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden. Unclear: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Estonia, Greece.
- The page shows **"Last update: 17 June 2026"**, so it has not changed in about 4 months. Its Germany entry still describes the February 2026 cabinet draft, and its Poland entry still says the bill is waiting for the Senate. Both are now out of date. [Spanish mirror](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/es/national-implementation-plans)
- One search summary mentioned a "June 2026" snapshot showing 10/11/6, but I could not confirm it. The live page shows 9.

## 2. Current status

- Nothing is settled yet. On the live page the count is 9, which falls in the "≤9" bucket. The outcome depends mostly on **whether the tracker's maintainers update the page before Metaculus checks it**.
- If they do update it, at least three states seem likely to move to Clear based on events since June 17:
  - Germany: the KI-MIG law names the Bundesnetzagentur as market surveillance authority, and one source says the DAkkS accreditation body acts as notifying authority.
  - Poland: the statute sets up KRiBSI.
  - Greece: Law 5321/2026 names HDPA (market surveillance) and EETT (notifying).
- That would give about 12, and possibly more with Sweden (designated by government decision) or others. This is my own reading of the tracker's criteria, not something the page says.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-10-23: Italy's Legislative Decree 179/2026 took effect, giving ACN and AgID supervisory roles. Italy is already Clear, so this does not change the count. [Tecnoandroid](https://www.tecnoandroid.it/news/ai-act-in-italia-acn-e-agid-vigilano-dal-23-ottobre-2026-2001378/)
- 2026-10-28 (upcoming): the parts of Poland's AI law on inspections and penalties take effect. [Gazeta Prawna / Sejm text](https://api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2026/1003/text.pdf)
- 2026-08-17: a third-party tracker lists 9 states as formally designated, but with a different set: it adds Germany and Poland, and drops Denmark and Slovenia (labelled partial or pending). It describes Sweden as having five authorities designated by government decision on June 12, with no statute. [agentliability.eu](https://agentliability.eu/articles/eu-ai-act-member-state-transposition-status-tracker-2026)
- 2026-07-28: Germany's KI-MIG was published in the Federal Law Gazette and took effect 2026-07-29. The Bundestag passed it on June 11 and the Bundesrat approved it on July 10. [Simmons & Simmons](https://www.simmons-simmons.com/en/publications/cms4tri8600p6uom8vhygodt9/the-german-ai-act-implementing-law-key-provisions-and-concerns); [gesetze-im-internet](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ki-mig/BJNR0DF0B0026.html)
- 2026-07-24: Poland's president signed the AI systems act (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1003). [Prawo.pl](https://www.prawo.pl/biznes/prezydent-podpisal-ustawe-o-systemach-ai,1541891.html)
- 2026-07-16: Greece adopted Law 5321/2026. [EY](https://www.ey.com/en_gr/technical/tax/tax-alerts/ai-act-greek-legal-framework-for-the-supervision-of-artificial-intelligence-systems); [Licentium](https://www.licentium.io/post/greece-adopts-ai-act-national-implementation-law-5321-2026)
- 2026-05-26: Spain sent its bill to Congress. The Netherlands published its draft act on 2026-04-20. Both were still pending as of August. [Legal500](https://www.legal500.com/intelligence/netherlands/technology/dutch-implementation-of-the-ai-act-decentralised-ai-supervision)

## 4. Base rates

- 2025-05-19: an earlier version of the tracker showed about 3 Clear and 14 with no authority. [search summary of tracker](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/national-implementation-plans/)
- 2026-06-17: 9 Clear. That is roughly +6 in 13 months, or about 0.5 per month, but the updates come in occasional batches.
- I could not find the full update history (Wayback Machine was blocked). The page went at least 4 months without an update (June to October 2026) even though there was major legislation in that time. A tracker that stays stale is a real possibility.

## 5. Other forecasts

- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets provided match this question. They cover a US AI regulator, LLM leadership, EU diesel stocks and similar topics.
- I found no Manifold market or expert forecast on this tracker's count.

## 6. Upcoming events before December 1

- Possible tracker update. Germany, Poland and Greece already look ready to be reclassified, which would push the count to about 12 or more.
- Poland: KRiBSI powers start 2026-10-28, and the body is expected to be operational around November 2026.
- Pending laws: Spain (in Congress), Netherlands (draft), Luxembourg (Bill 8476 in committee), Czech Republic, Romania (Pl-x 184/2025). I found no confirmation that any of them will be adopted before December.
- The tracker could also move existing Clear states down, for example Denmark or Slovenia, which other trackers rate as partial. I see no sign of this happening.

Sources: [AIAct tracker](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/national-implementation-plans/), [AIAct ES mirror](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/es/national-implementation-plans), [agentliability.eu](https://agentliability.eu/articles/eu-ai-act-member-state-transposition-status-tracker-2026), [Simmons & Simmons](https://www.simmons-simmons.com/en/publications/cms4tri8600p6uom8vhygodt9/the-german-ai-act-implementing-law-key-provisions-and-concerns), [gesetze-im-internet](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ki-mig/BJNR0DF0B0026.html), [Prawo.pl](https://www.prawo.pl/biznes/prezydent-podpisal-ustawe-o-systemach-ai,1541891.html), [Sejm text](https://api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2026/1003/text.pdf), [EY Greece](https://www.ey.com/en_gr/technical/tax/tax-alerts/ai-act-greek-legal-framework-for-the-supervision-of-artificial-intelligence-systems), [Licentium](https://www.licentium.io/post/greece-adopts-ai-act-national-implementation-law-5321-2026), [Legal500](https://www.legal500.com/intelligence/netherlands/technology/dutch-implementation-of-the-ai-act-decentralised-ai-supervision), [Tecnoandroid](https://www.tecnoandroid.it/news/ai-act-in-italia-acn-e-agid-vigilano-dal-23-ottobre-2026-2001378/)

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** about 5 weeks. The outcome is known when Metaculus checks the tracker on or after 2026-12-01.

(b) **Status quo:** the live tracker shows 9 Clear states, with "Last update: 17 June 2026". If nothing changes, this resolves "≤9".

(c) **Base rates:**
- The tracker went from about 3 Clear (May 2025) to 9 Clear (June 2026), roughly 0.5 states per month.
- It updates in irregular batches, not continuously.
- It has now gone more than 4 months without an update, even though Germany, Poland and Greece passed major laws in that time.
- Over a 5-week window, I estimate the chance of a refresh at roughly 40-50%.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- **Live count (2026-10-26):** 9 Clear, page dated 17 June 2026.
- **Germany:** KI-MIG took effect 2026-07-29. It names the Bundesnetzagentur as market surveillance authority, and possibly DAkkS as notifying authority.
- **Poland:** the AI systems act was signed 2026-07-24 and sets up KRiBSI. Its powers start 2026-10-28.
- **Greece:** Law 5321/2026 was adopted 2026-07-16. It names HDPA (market surveillance) and EETT (notifying).
- **Sweden:** authorities were designated by government decision on 2026-06-12, with no statute.
- **Still pending:** Spain, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Czech Republic and Romania have not adopted their laws. None looks likely to pass before December.
- **If the tracker is refreshed:** the most likely count is about 12, possibly 13 with Sweden. A strict reading of the "notifying authority" criterion for Germany or Poland could leave it at 10-11.

(e) **Unexpected scenario:**
- The maintainers do a broad end-of-year refresh. They add Germany, Poland, Greece, Sweden and some states with secondary acts, such as Latvia or Portugal, reaching 14 or more.
- Alternatively, a refresh downgrades Denmark or Slovenia while adding only one or two states, which keeps the count at or near 9.

**How far I moved:** I start from the status quo (≤9), because the page has been stale for over 4 months. I keep about 55% there. The remaining 45% goes to an update, spread mainly across 12-13, with some weight on 10-11 for a partial or strict update and smaller weight on the higher buckets.

Option_A: 0.54
Option_B: 0.15
Option_C: 0.21
Option_D: 0.07
Option_E: 0.03
